listing.name: Hot Shots Tennis — OpenTennis (FIZL0)
listing.summary: The released native runtime is reported to support gameplay. The second-match camera, Set Handicap and Offbeat Rules remain missing; let serves have not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA v1.00 SCUS-97610 ISO and keep it available while playing. Other regions are rejected. No BIOS is required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s native runtime from Releases for your host. Select your own ISO in the first-run picker and keep it available; the runtime reads it during play. The browser player is a separate delivery option for the same rewrite.

warnings: The released native runtime is reported to support gameplay. The second-match camera, Set Handicap and Offbeat Rules remain missing; let serves have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
